left.text: The caller described a man talking to himself in the street. He's gone. The caller wants to know why it took you so long.

crisis.text: A man in a hospital bracelet is standing in traffic, arguing with someone only he can see.

options.text: Talk to him. Slowly. Name first.
Get him out of the street, hands-on.

success.note: He fights you to the curb and then just stops.

crisis_talk.text: He tells you his name is Tomás and the cars are listening. He walks to the curb with you.

options.text: Place him on a 5150 hold for evaluation.

success.note: Three hours at County. He thanks you, once.

options.text: Get him to a shelter bed instead.

success.note: The shelter has one bed left. He takes it. Maybe.

crisis_worse.text: He backs further into traffic. A bus brakes hard.

knife.text: A woman in a doorway is holding a kitchen knife against her own wrist. Her mother is behind you on the sidewalk, begging.

options.text: Call for a mental evaluation team and hold.

success.note: She drops. The knife skitters away. Her mother screams anyway.

knife_talk.text: She sets the knife on the step. She sits down next to it and won't look at you.

options.text: Secure the knife, then a 5150 hold.
